{{Disambig|Wraith}}

==Enemies==
'''Wraith''' may refer to these [[Enemies]]:
*[[Frost Wraith]],  a hidden enemy that first appears on Wave 18 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode 
**[[Frost Wraith/Advanced Stats]]

It may also refer to these event [[Enemies]]:
*[[Corrupted Wraith]], an enemy that appears in the [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]
*[[Hex Wraith]],  an average health enemy found in [[The Nightmare Realm|Night II]] and [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
**[[Hex Wraith/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Wraith]], a hidden enemy found in [[Foggy Forest|Night II]], [[Tower Outskirts|Night III]] and [[Totality Tower|Night IV]] of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]

==Skins==
'''Wraith''' may refer to these skins:
*[[Ranger/Gallery|{{Color|Premium|Wraith}} Ranger]] skin
*[[Minigunner/Gallery|{{Color|Premium|Wraith}} Minigunner]] skin
